reply.template.row.text: {name} (scope {scope}{hasFrom, select, yes {, from {from}} other {}}, file {file}): {agents} agents{hasWorkflow, select, yes {, workflow for {workflow}} other {}}{hasProblem, select, yes {. Can't be used: {problem}} other {}}
reply.template.row.note: cw_template list: a template, what load needs to name it (scope, from and file), its agents and workflow, and why it can't be used.

reply.template.taken.note: cw_template plan: names taken, each with a free one.

reply.template.takenOne.note: A name taken by another project's agent, and a free one.

reply.template.wf.changes.note: A template's workflow: how many options it changes (or changed), each old → new.

reply.template.wf.dropped.text: Its workflow ({platforms}) can't be used here.
reply.template.wf.dropped.note: A template's workflow that can't apply here.

reply.template.wf.gitOnly.text: Its workflow is for Git only and this project has no version control.
reply.template.wf.gitOnly.note: A template's workflow that can't apply: Git only.

reply.template.wf.line.text: {head}{hasMissing, select, yes {; checks with no command here (set them in Version Control): {commands}} other {}}{identityOff, select, yes {; identity stays off (no git identity here)} other {}}.{keep, select, yes { Lanes and cards in flight keep their rules.} other {}}
reply.template.wf.line.note: A template's workflow in a plan's or a load's reply: what it changes, checks with no command, the identity left off.

reply.template.wf.noChanges.note: A template's workflow that changes no option.

reply.template.wf.none.text: it has none for this project
reply.template.wf.none.note: Why a load's workflow wasn't saved, where none is given.

reply.template.wf.notSaved.note: A load's workflow not saved, and why.

reply.template.wf.plan.note: A plan's workflow: what it would change.

reply.undo.before.note: cw_undo: this change had been undone before. {name} is its card or what it was.

reply.undo.field.note: cw_undo: a field left as it is, why (reply.undo.skipped.*) and the error if one was given.

reply.undo.final.note: cw_undo: this change can't be undone, and why.

reply.undo.group.text: {group} (your message at {at}): {n, plural, one {{n} change} other {{n} changes}}, {left} to undo{hasCards, select, yes {; cards {cards}} other {}}
reply.undo.group.note: A message's line in cw_undo's list (#1282): its group id, when, how many changes and how many are left to undo, and its cards.

reply.undo.head.text: Undid {done} of {n, plural, one {{n} change} other {{n} changes}} in full.
reply.undo.head.note: cw_undo's reply (#1282): how many changes were undone in full, of how many.

reply.undo.listMore.text: and {n} more: undo the group to undo them all.
reply.undo.listMore.note: cw_undo's list of a message's changes, cut at 40: how many more.

reply.undo.markFinal.note: A mark after one of the Assistant's changes in cw_undo's list (#1282): it can't be undone, and why.

reply.undo.markUndone.note: A mark after one of the Assistant's changes in cw_undo's list (#1282): it has been undone.

reply.undo.more.text: and {n} more left as they were.
reply.undo.more.note: cw_undo's notes, cut at 40: how many more were left.

reply.undo.none.text: No changes of yours are kept (they are kept 7 days).
reply.undo.none.note: cw_undo's list when none of the Assistant's changes is kept (#1282).

reply.undo.noneForGroup.text: No changes of yours are kept for message {group}.
reply.undo.noneForGroup.note: cw_undo's list for one message (#1282) when none is kept. {group} is the message's group id.

reply.undo.partial.note: cw_undo: what of this change was put back, and each field left (reply.undo.field, joined by ", ").

reply.undo.skipped.changed.note: Why an undo left a field: it changed since the Assistant changed it.

reply.undo.skipped.ended.note: Why an undo left a field: what it was on has ended.

reply.undo.skipped.failed.note: Why an undo left a field: putting it back was refused.

reply.undo.skipped.gone.note: Why an undo left a field: what it was on is gone.

reply.usage.limit.note: An account's limit (HI-2195): its share used and when it resets (UTC).

reply.usage.line.note: cw_connection list's line for an account's usage (joined by "; ").

reply.usage.move.text: moves its agents to {to} at {percent}% of {limit, select, weekly {the weekly limit} fiveHour {the 5-hour limit} other {either limit}}
reply.usage.move.note: An account's usage move (HI-2195): where its agents move, at what share of which limit.

reply.usage.noFigures.note: An account with no usage figures yet.

reply.wait.already.note: A watch whose condition was met already: no watch started.

reply.wait.alsoAgents.text: {agents} finishing, waiting for the user or stopping
reply.wait.alsoAgents.note: What else wakes a lane watch: its agents.

reply.wait.alsoCards.note: What else wakes a lane watch: a change to its cards.

reply.wait.comment.note: A watched card's change, with its latest comment's author and first line (cw_read_task with latestComment gives it all).

reply.wait.dropped.note: A lane watch: cards that left it.

reply.wait.endTurn.text: End your turn now: Combwork types a line into this session when it changes, or at {limit} if nothing does.
reply.wait.endTurn.note: A card watch begun: end the turn, and what wakes it.

reply.wait.endTurnThen.text: end your turn: Combwork types a line into this session when it changes, or at {limit} if nothing does.
reply.wait.endTurnThen.note: HI-2245: after handing a card over first, what to do then.

reply.wait.ended.note: HI-2195: a usage watch already met ends the watch before it.

reply.wait.gone.text: {card} {archived, select, yes {was archived} other {was archived or deleted}}
reply.wait.gone.note: A watched card that is gone.

reply.wait.idle.text: {watching}. {idle} Combwork types a line into this session when it changes, or at {limit} if nothing does.
reply.wait.idle.note: HI-2285: a lane's builder watching only its own card with nothing waiting on it carries on rather than end the turn.

reply.wait.inLanes.text: Warning: {cards} {one, select, yes {is a card} other {are cards}} of the lanes you watch: listed too, {one, select, yes {it wakes} other {they wake}} you on every move. For a lane, pass lanes only.
reply.wait.inLanes.note: A lane watch given cards of its own lanes: they wake the agent on every move.

reply.wait.keptAgents.text: It kept {agents} from your last lane watch (agents: [] for none).
reply.wait.keptAgents.note: A lane watch (HI-1987): the agents beside its lanes it kept from the last lane watch.

reply.wait.keptCards.text: It kept {cards} from your last lane watch (cards: [] for none).
reply.wait.keptCards.note: A lane watch (#726): the cards beside its lanes it kept from the last lane watch.

reply.wait.lane.text: {watching}{events}. End your turn now: Combwork types a line into this session on a lane event{hasAlso, select, yes { or {also}} other {}}, or at {limit} if none comes.
reply.wait.lane.note: A lane watch begun (#531): what it watches (and its events, when they aren't the default), and what wakes it.

reply.wait.lanesLeft.text: This replaces your lane watch: {n, plural, one {1 running lane ({lanes}) is} other {{n} running lanes ({lanes}) are}} no longer followed. To follow them as well, watch them with this instead: cw_wait_for_tasks with lanes, and agents or cards.
reply.wait.lanesLeft.note: HI-1987: a card or agent watch that replaces a lane watch while its lanes run says what it drops, and how to keep them.

reply.wait.moved.text: {card} is in {column} ({changes}{hasBy, select, yes {, by {by}} other {}})
reply.wait.moved.note: A watched card that changed: its column, what changed, and who changed it.

reply.wait.noChange.note: A bounded wait with no change.

reply.wait.noLonger.note: A lane watch: the last lane watch's cards it no longer watches.

reply.wait.notFollowed.note: A lane watch: agents not followed for not working now, each with its state.

reply.wait.replaceCards.note: A lane watch: its cards replace the last lane watch's.

reply.wait.replaced.note: A watch begun: the watch it replaced.

reply.wait.since.note: The since to pass to the next bounded wait (a parameter name: keep it).

reply.wait.theLimit.note: When a watch ends if nothing comes, where its limit's time isn't known.

reply.wait.watching.note: A card watch begun: what it waits for, then what to do (reply.wait.endTurn, or hand a card over first).

reply.warning.note: A warning on a line of its own after a reply (an intent's, a refusal's). {warning} is its text.
